account_created.subject: Account Created
account_created.intro: You are receiving this email because an account was created for you on {{ settings.app.name }}.
account_created.instruction: Please click the button below to securely set your password and access your account:
account_created.note: Note: For security reasons, this link will expire in 20 minutes.
account_created.footer: If you did not request this account, you can safely ignore this email.

password_reset.subject: Password Reset
password_reset.intro: We received a request to reset the password for your account on {{ settings.app.name }}.
password_reset.instruction: If you made this request, please click the button below to choose a new password:
password_reset.note: Note: This link will expire in 20 minutes.
password_reset.footer: If you did not request a password reset, please ignore this email. Your password will remain unchanged and your account is secure.

email_verification.subject: Verify Your Email
email_verification.intro: Please confirm that {{ email }} belongs to you to finish setting up your account on {{ settings.app.name }}.
email_verification.note: Note: This link will expire in 24 hours.
email_verification.footer: If you did not create this account or request this change, please ignore this email. Nothing will be changed.

two_factor_code.subject: Your Login Code
two_factor_code.intro: Use the code below to finish signing in to {{ settings.app.name }}.
two_factor_code.note: Note: This code will expire in 10 minutes and can only be used once.
two_factor_code.footer: If you did not try to sign in, someone else may know your password. We recommend changing it as soon as possible.

session_created.subject: New Session Created
session_created.intro: Your account was just signed in to on {{ settings.app.name }}.
session_created.note: Note: If this was you, no action is needed. You can revoke any session you do not recognize from your account settings.
session_created.footer: If you did not sign in, someone else may know your password. We recommend changing it as soon as possible.

connection_test.subject: Connection Test
connection_test.intro: You are receiving this email because an administrator on {{ settings.app.name }} requested a test message to verify the system's outbound mail settings.
connection_test.footer: This is an automated test message from your application. No further action is required.

added_to_server.subject: Added to Server
added_to_server.intro: You are receiving this email because you have been added as a subuser on {{ server.name }}.
added_to_server.instruction: Click the button below to access the server:

removed_from_server.subject: Removed from Server
removed_from_server.intro: You are receiving this email because you have been removed as a subuser from {{ server.name }}.
removed_from_server.footer: There is no action required on your side. If you believe this was a mistake, please contact the server's administrator for more information.

server_installed.subject: Server Installed
server_installed.intro: You are receiving this email because your server, {{ server.name }}, has finished its installation.
server_installed.instruction: Click the button below to access the server:

server_restored.subject: Server Restored
server_restored.intro: You are receiving this email because your server, {{ server.name }}, has finished its restoration from a backup.
server_restored.instruction: Click the button below to access the server:
